newsitem.title: USA: U.S. at work on new designs for nuclear arms-paper.
newsitem.headline: U.S. at work on new designs for nuclear arms-paper.

text.p: The United States is at work on new or modified designs for nuclear weapons, even though the Cold War has ended, the New York Times, citing a formerly secret Energy Department document, reported on Monday.
The document showed that the U.S. was undermining a treaty intended to halt innovations in making weapons of mass destruction, the newspaper said.

Energy Department officials denied the assertion, saying the work complied with the international treaty. The officials said the work was only being undertaken to modernise old weapon designs, the paper said.
The document was quoted as saying the work exercised a broad range of design skills, including steps toward redesigning the heart of the hydrogen bomb.
The document was obtained by the Natural Resources Defense Council -- a private Washington group that advocates arms control -- and turned over to the Times, the paper said.
